timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I'll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you'll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let's begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel a little sad right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I don't need a reason to feel this way.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: It's okay to let this be here.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don't have to push this feeling away.
I can be gentle with myself right now.
This feeling doesn't have to last forever.
I'm allowed to feel this without judging myself for it.
I can let a little bit of comfort in.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I'm allowing myself to feel cared for.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. You met yourself here — that's worth something.
